system.description:
Allied creatures that take damage while standing on this terrain have some of the harm they suffer shared with the terrain. They take 4 less damage. This increases to 8 damage at 7th level and 12 damage at 15th level.

| #### Lava Chakra Mode / Battle Amp / Your body is engulfed in Lava in the shape of a battle armor of your design. You gain the following benefits for the duration; / You gain a +2 Bonus to your AC. / When you create a Molten Terrain, as a result of the Magma Domain feature, you can creature 2 Molten Terrains simultaneously. / Hostile creatures that deal damage to you as a result of a melee attack, takes 10 fire damage. / Difficult terrain you create using jutsu with the Earth Release keyword can be treated as Molten Terrain. / When you inflict ranks of Burned as a result of a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you can instead inflict the Molten condition. |
